decided.why: Kept — the premise does not hold. The Checks tab only exists when ci.checks has rows; for rollup-only hosts and PRs cached before the per-check breakdown there is no tab at all and the pill is the only CI signal. It is also the tab's entry point (pr-summary routes its click to onShowChecks), which two e2e tests assert.
